tools.name: create_personalized_song
tools.title: Create a personalized song with audio
tools.description: Create a 30-second personalized song (lyrics + signed mp3 URL valid 24 h) that sings the given name. For adult-facing apps only (parents, teachers). Send a free CucuTime developer key as Authorization: Bearer <key> in Claude Code, Cursor or the REST API; MCP connectors (Claude.ai and other clients with OAuth support) can use https://cucutime.org/mcp/auth with Google sign-in instead.

name.description: First name only (no surnames or personal data), 1-40 letters, to sing.

theme.description: What the song is about (3-300 characters).

age.description: Optional age, used only to adapt the lyrics.

tools.name: generate_song_idea
tools.title: Draft a song idea
tools.description: Draft a song concept for a child’s first name and a theme: title, music style, companion character, a chorus with the name and a 4-part verse outline, plus 3 CucuTime YouTube videos on the theme. Useful for a personalized, birthday or bedtime song idea for a named child, before writing lyrics or creating audio. Returns text and links, not audio. Free, no key, no AI.

name.description: Child’s first name only (no surnames or personal data).

theme.description: Occasion, topic or style (e.g. birthday, bedtime, animals, dinosaurs, space, bravery, starting preschool).

language.description: Output language matching the request (en, es or pt; default en).

tools.name: get_song_for_name
tools.title: Find a name page and free sample link
tools.description: Find the ready-made CucuTime page and free sample link for a child’s first name (English, Spanish or Portuguese). Useful when a parent, relative or teacher asks for a song, birthday song, lullaby or song idea for a named child. When a pre-recorded 30-second sample exists for that name and language, also returns its direct mp3 link (made in advance; no AI runs on the call), plus 3 CucuTime YouTube videos. If no page exists, returns a text idea and sample link instead. For a child’s name, this is the tool to use, not search_catalog. Free, no key.

name.description: Child’s first name only (no surnames or personal data).

language.description: Page language matching the request (en, es or pt; default en).

tools.name: moderate_kids_text
tools.title: Check text for young children
tools.description: Check whether a text is appropriate for young children (ages 2-8). Returns {safe}. For adult-facing apps only. Send a free CucuTime developer key as Authorization: Bearer <key> in Claude Code, Cursor or the REST API; MCP connectors (Claude.ai and other clients with OAuth support) can use https://cucutime.org/mcp/auth with Google sign-in instead.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.title: Find songs in the CucuTime catalog
tools.description: Find existing CucuTime kids’ songs and educational videos on YouTube by words in their titles (English, Spanish or Portuguese; most videos are in Spanish and Portuguese). Useful when a parent or teacher wants songs or videos to watch or play: animal characters, dance, early learning (colors, shapes, numbers, emotions) and a few daily habits or routines (bedtime, teeth, tidying up) for home or preschool. Generic words (song, routine, kids, preschool) are ignored and a few everyday topics (birthday, bedtime, teeth, tidying up, colors, numbers, letters, shapes, emotions, body) also match their usual title words; any other word must appear in a title, so search one simple word and check suggestions and approximate alternatives when there are no exact matches. Returns YouTube links. Free, no key, no AI.

query.description: One simple word from video titles in the target language, such as an animal, a learning topic or a habit (e.g. elefante, baila, colores, emociones, dormir, dientes, ordenar). Generic words are ignored and everyday topics match their usual title words; any other word must appear in the title, so avoid long phrases and never send a child’s name. Empty = latest uploads.

language.description: Only videos in this language (most are Spanish or Portuguese; few are English). Omit for any language.

resources.name: catalog-themes
resources.title: Catalog themes and languages
resources.description: Title words and video counts from CucuTime’s own YouTube uploads (animal characters, dance, early learning and a few daily habits; mostly Spanish and Portuguese), grouped by language.

resources.name: get-a-key
resources.title: Get and configure a developer key
resources.description: Free adult-only trial, client setup and Bearer authentication.

prompts.name: birthday-song
prompts.title: Plan a birthday song
prompts.description: Look up a child’s name page and draft a personalized birthday song concept before making audio.

prompts.name: classroom-routine
prompts.title: Find a classroom routine song
prompts.description: Search CucuTime videos for a classroom routine or topic (characters, dance, early learning, bedtime, teeth, tidying up).

prompts.name: kid-safe-check
prompts.title: Check text for young children
prompts.description: Check text using the adult-only moderation tool, or learn how to connect for it.
